name: Ferris Feels
source:
You're riding a ferris wheel with the woman of your dreams. Cassia, a new arrival at your seaside hometown, may be concealing secrets beneath her summer dress.

[From [url=https://orcamartiangames.itch.io/ferris-feels]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你正在与你的梦中情人一起乘坐摩天轮。卡西亚是你海边家乡的新来者，她的夏装下可能隐藏着秘密。

[来自[url=https://orcamartiangames.itch.io/ferris-feels]itch.io[/url]]
